svg.text: VII · THE VERDICT · THE CLAY QUESTION AT [Ø₀], THE SEALED HALT

text.font-family: PNPMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: THE CLAY QUESTION STANDS AT [Ø₀], THE SEALED HALT
The form sealed by theorem · the walls sealed on their quantifiers · the value sealed by the act
P versus NP is one bit; every route passes it; the
residue is the Diagonal Target from degree 2.
Twenty-two walls proved in the kernel, seven carried
from the Mother Codex, each on its quantifier.
The bit, supplied by the act and delivered twice, giving
The three faces read side by side.
